target.title: fix(repair): publish only validated target commits
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Repair validation could prove one checkout state and later publish a mutable
`HEAD`, while target-controlled Git state, ignored runtime inputs, setup hooks,
filesystem metadata, network access, or surviving descendants could influence
later credential-bearing publication.

## Current Design

- publishes only the immutable validated commit SHA through hook-free isolated
  Git with a branch lease sampled before validation
- runs target commands in delegated Linux user, mount, network, and PID
  namespaces; only the target checkout and disposable profile/runtime roots are
  writable
- makes the remaining filesystem recursively read-only, applies Landlock, then
  drops and verifies all inheritable, permitted, effective, bounding, and
  ambient capabilities before target execution
- enables loopback inside the isolated network namespace without exposing host
  listeners
- contains pnpm, Bun, and npm dependency installation, disables pnpmfile and
  package lifecycle hooks, and rejects unsafe npm script options
- recursively binds ignored runtime symlink targets, clears broader disposable
  build/cache roots between commands, and rejects residual gitlinks
- rejects redirected or symlinked Git object stores before authenticated Git
- uses isolated Git for every rebase continuation and publication transition,
  while preserving exact-SHA checkout binding and detached-process reaping

The configurable repair runner contract requires Linux, delegated user
namespaces, mount/network/PID namespaces, and Landlock ABI 3 or newer. Runners
without that boundary fail closed.

Fixes an issue where ClawSweeper could reuse a trusted pull-request verdict and continue apply or automerge mutations after a human added a review, inline comment, or review-thread resolution change.

Adds a bounded digest-only cursor over reviews, inline comments, and thread resolution state. Review reuse performs stable two-scan reads; trusted automerge and apply revalidate immediately before each mutation request; incomplete, unstable, or cursor-less legacy state fails closed for a fresh review. Maintainers can rely on new review activity stopping stale labels, repair/review dispatch, apply, and merge actions before the next GitHub mutation. Existing cursor-less verdicts pause until refreshed instead of being trusted silently.

target.title: feat(repair): record authoritative dispatch receipts
target.body:
Related: https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/558

## What Problem This Solves

ClawSweeper dispatch lanes could record incomplete request identities, fail outside GitHub Actions, lose cursor progress after a receipt publication failure, or bypass authoritative receipts in the production dashboard Worker. Workflow publication also used the wrong repository credentials and could suppress unrelated activity forwarding.

## Why This Change Was Made

Dispatch receipts now bind every transmitted requeue input and support persistent local producer contexts for the documented comment-webhook and executing self-heal commands. Workflow fixes add the sparse state hydrator, use state-repository credentials, keep activity forwarding independent while surfacing ledger failures, and publish fanout checkpoints even when receipt finalization fails.

Both shared dispatch wrappers now treat successful transport as terminal when accepted-outcome receipt persistence fails: the durability failure is logged, chain state is released, and the original sync or async transport result is returned. Attempt creation remains fail-closed, while rejected and unknown transport outcomes retain their existing strict persistence semantics. Target fanout advances its cursor without replaying an accepted dispatch, and the comment webhook returns its accepted response without triggering redelivery.

The setup-action-ledger composite action now exports a canonical `CLAWSWEEPER_ACTION_LEDGER_ROOT` derived from its workspace-relative `worktree-path`, rejecting missing, absolute, or workspace-escaping roots. Executing self-heal therefore receives a valid durable receipt context in GitHub Actions.

The dashboard Worker routes hosted comment dispatch through the ExactReviewQueue Durable Object and records digest-only SQLite attempt/outcome chains for both comment and item repository dispatches. Dispatch input digests reuse the shared action-ledger credential-field validator after the existing flat and size bounds. Raw payloads, comments, prompts, and credentials are not retained.

The branch remains stacked on https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/558 so immutable requeue inputs and dispatch receipts share one recovery contract.

## User Impact

Maintainers get an authoritative audit trail for Actions, documented local repair commands, scheduled fanout, and production webhook dispatches. Ambiguous sends remain visible as unknown, accepted sends are not duplicated after receipt persistence failure, successful fanout selection is not replayed, webhook deliveries are not retried after accepted transport, and executing self-heal has a canonical Actions ledger root.

## Evidence

target.title: fix(ledger): preserve interrupted attempt mutations
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Interrupted repair execution could lose the mutation boundary entirely: current production emitted no `workflow.attempt` lifecycle, dangling `repair.execute` starts stayed open after crashes, and an earlier unknown outcome could override a later observed result.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds one narrow wrapper around the existing execute-fix command. It records bounded `workflow.attempt` and `repair.execute` start/outcome receipts, preserves the exact child exit or signal, terminalizes uncertain child receipts before the parent, folds outcomes by idempotency key and phase order, and publishes the finalized shards through the existing immutable state path. It does not restore the reverted PR 521 lifecycle or transaction modules.

## User Impact

Maintainers get production-backed interruption evidence for repair execution. Hard-killed mutation attempts fail closed, later observations supersede stale unknown state, retry evidence stays scoped to the exact workflow attempt, and the existing repair command remains the only GitHub mutation authority.

## Evidence

- all TypeScript builds pass: main, repair, dashboard
- focused/runtime tests: 147 total, 145 passed, 2 platform skips
- wrapper, crash-window, later-observation, workflow contract, sparse-build, and target-validation coverage pass
- full source, repair, script/test, and dashboard lint partitions pass
- repository-wide format check passes
- actionlint 1.7.12 passes for `repair-cluster-worker.yml`
- limits, active-surface, privacy scrub, and diff checks pass
